facts.content: Assessment is acute unilateral migraine headache with visual aura features and associated nausea and vomiting, onset this morning, with paracetamol ineffective.
facts.source_text: 1) Acute unilateral migraine headache with visual aura features (blurred vision with zigzag lines) and associated nausea/vomiting; onset this morning; paracetamol ineffective.

facts.content: Plan is to treat symptoms of suspected migraine with oral ibuprofen and an antiemetic as needed.
facts.source_text:
• Symptom management for suspected migraine:
  - Ibuprofen (PO) with an antiemetic as needed.

facts.content: Patient is advised to take a sugar-containing beverage such as cola as part of symptomatic management.
facts.source_text: - Recommend sugar-containing beverage (e.g., cola) as part of the symptomatic plan.

facts.content: Consider use of Migraleve if over-the-counter regimen is insufficient.
facts.source_text: - Consider Migraleve if OTC regimen insufficient.

facts.content: A same-day neurological assessment is to be scheduled to confirm the examination and rule out other etiologies if symptoms persist or worsen.
facts.source_text: - Schedule same-day neurological assessment to confirm exam and rule out other etiologies if symptoms persist or worsen.

facts.content: If there is rapid improvement in symptoms, the neurological appointment can be canceled.
facts.source_text: - If rapid improvement occurs, can cancel the appointment.

facts.content: Patient is instructed to return or seek urgent care if new focal neurological signs such as weakness, slurred speech, or confusion develop, or if fever, neck stiffness, or significant worsening of headache occurs.
facts.source_text: - Return or seek urgent care if new focal neurological signs develop (weakness, slurred speech, confusion), fever, neck stiffness, or if headache worsens significantly.
